address: 28/1 Phran Nok-Phutthamonthon 4 Road, Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok, 10170, Thailand
bio: This gem of a place serves fresh seafood with Thai flavours, featuring house-made curry and chilli paste. Order in advance or call to check availability. Try the stir-fried crab with bird's eye chilli or the non-spicy stir-fried squid with curry powder....
